title: Comment Moderation
subtitle: Automatically handle offensive or abusive comments on your Facebook pages.
autoDesc: When our AI detects a comment as offensive or abusive, act on it automatically instead of just flagging it for review.
actionLabel: When a comment is flagged offensive or abusive
actionHideHint: Reversible — the comment is hidden from everyone except its author. You can unhide it anytime.
actionDeleteHint: Permanent — the comment is removed for everyone and cannot be restored.
blockLabel: Also block the author from the page
blockHint: The author can no longer comment or message the page. You can unblock them later.
reviewNote: Hidden comments appear in your Comments inbox with a “Hidden” badge, where you can unhide them.
saveError: Couldn't save settings. Please try again.
